name: swiss-ball-barbell-press.html
instructions:
1. Grab a barbell or EZ bar using a pronated grip and sit on the center of an exercise ball with your feet around shoulder width apart.
2. Raise the barbell to shoulder height on each side. Your palms should be facing forward. This is the starting position for the exercise.
3. Take a deep breath then press the barbell overhead by extending the elbows and contracting the deltoids.
4. Slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
